scope: Technical crawl/index/render discoverability for public web content. Search operations are manual/external.

checks.title: Intended indexable pages are not accidentally blocked/noindexed
checks.next_step: Check meta/X-Robots-Tag, auth/staging gates and representative deployed routes.

checks.title: robots.txt matches crawl intent
checks.next_step: Fetch deployed robots.txt and confirm it does not accidentally block intended content.

checks.title: Sitemap is valid/current where useful
checks.next_step: Validate XML/URLs/freshness if the site benefits from a sitemap; otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE.

checks.title: Canonicalization is coherent where duplicate URLs exist
checks.next_step: Check duplicate/parameterized routes, redirects, internal links and declared canonicals; canonical tags are hints, not universally mandatory.

checks.title: HTTP status codes and redirect chains reflect page intent
checks.next_step: Crawl representative routes for 2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx, loops and excessive chains.

checks.title: Primary indexable content is available in rendered output
checks.next_step: Compare initial/rendered HTML for JS-heavy routes and ensure critical content/links are discoverable.

checks.title: Page titles are unique/useful for important indexable pages
checks.next_step: Inspect representative route templates and duplicates.

checks.title: Meta descriptions are present/useful where worthwhile
checks.next_step: Treat as snippet-quality guidance, not an indexing/ranking requirement.

checks.title: Heading structure supports content comprehension
checks.next_step: Review hierarchy and semantics; do not enforce one-H1 folklore as a hard rule.

checks.title: Meaningful images have appropriate alternative text
checks.next_step: Decorative images may have empty alt; this is primarily accessibility/content semantics.

checks.title: Relevant structured data is valid and matches visible content
checks.next_step: Validate only eligible schema types and record validator/result.

checks.title: Important pages are discoverable through internal links
checks.next_step: Crawl for orphan/weakly linked pages and navigation paths.

checks.title: Material internal links resolve correctly
checks.next_step: Crawl representative internal links and classify intentional/non-indexable destinations.

checks.title: Duplicate/thin/faceted URL behavior is controlled
checks.next_step: Review parameter/facet/search pages, duplicate content, soft-404 patterns and canonical/indexing strategy.

checks.title: International targeting/hreflang is correct where applicable
checks.next_step: Check reciprocal/valid language-region annotations only for multilingual/multiregional sites.

checks.title: Redirect/indexing plan exists for URL/site migrations
checks.next_step: Apply only when URLs/domains/platform are changing.

checks.title: HTTPS and canonical host behavior are correct
checks.next_step: Treat as shared platform prerequisite; SEO consumes this result rather than owning transport security.

checks.title: Search Console/ownership and indexing diagnostics
checks.next_step: Optional search-operations evidence; not part of local automated scope.

checks.title: External authority/backlink analysis
checks.next_step: Optional off-site marketing/search-operations evidence; not a local code-quality check.

checks.title: llms.txt
checks.next_step: Optional/experimental. Absence is never a Google Search failure or ranking penalty.
